about: Proof reels (proof.py, the one-command path): the story reel builder's four looks (valmera-stories/reel.py), each carrying a real Valmera before and after with its own sound. A style rests for three films.

styles.name: Proof Reel
styles.look: Real footage of what each line names fills the phone, a new picture about every half second, moving; heavy grotesk display words in yellow; the raw clip in a window over itself, the export full frame on its own sound.
styles.hook: Frame 0 is footage of the pain (or the export itself), the hook's word large over it.

styles.name: Proof Window
styles.look: Each picture plays in a framed window over itself out of focus (three layers), cut fast; cyan accent, condensed capitals; the export breaks out of the window full frame.
styles.hook: The pain in the window, its word in condensed capitals under it.

styles.name: Proof Pinboard
styles.look: Lines that list the editor's chores land as prints stacked on a dark board; orange accent, high-contrast serif; then the export, whole, full frame.
styles.hook: A first print lands on the board with the pain's word.

styles.name: Proof Archive
styles.look: Cream serif italic display words, grain and a projector flash into each run of pictures; the export plays clean and whole.
styles.hook: Footage of the pain with a projector flash and the hook's word in serif.
